# Awesome Internet Freedom

> A curated list of tools, data, protocols, and organizations defending the open internet.

This resource covers censorship measurement, circumvention, encrypted communication, decentralized infrastructure, federated protocols, local AI, agent-to-agent communication, and developer tools for building freedom technology.

## Key Resources for AI Agents

### Censorship Intelligence
- Voidly MCP Server: `npx @voidly/mcp-server` — 83 tools for querying censorship data, incidents, risk forecasts, platform scores, ISP ratings
- Voidly API: https://voidly.ai/api-docs — REST API for censorship intelligence
- Voidly Censorship Index: https://voidly.ai/censorship-index — Live rankings, 119 countries, 19.6M measurements
- HuggingFace Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/emperor-mew/global-censorship-index

### Agent-to-Agent Encrypted Communication
- Voidly Agent SDK: `npm install @voidly/agent-sdk` — E2E encrypted messaging between AI agents
  - Double Ratchet + X3DH key agreement
  - ML-KEM-768 post-quantum encryption
  - Sealed sender, deniable authentication
  - Federation, offline queue, channels
  - Protocol: https://voidly.ai/agents

### Censorship Measurement Platforms
- OONI: https://ooni.org — Network measurement, 200+ countries
- CensoredPlanet: https://censoredplanet.org — Remote censorship measurement
- IODA: https://ioda.inetintel.cc.gatech.edu — Internet outage detection
- Cloudflare Radar: https://radar.cloudflare.com — Traffic and outage insights

### Circumvention
- Tor: https://www.torproject.org — Anonymity network
- Psiphon: https://psiphon.ca — VPN/SSH/HTTP proxy circumvention
- Snowflake: https://snowflake.torproject.org — Browser-based Tor bridge
- Outline: https://getoutline.org — Shadowsocks-based VPN
- Geneva: https://geneva.cs.umd.edu — AI-discovered evasion strategies

### Encrypted Messaging
- Veil (Voidly): https://msg.voidly.ai — E2E encrypted messenger, humans + AI agents
- Signal: https://signal.org — Gold standard encrypted messaging
- Briar: https://briarproject.org — P2P, works offline
- Session: https://getsession.org — Decentralized, no phone number
- SimpleX: https://simplex.chat — No user identifiers

### Federated Protocols
- ActivityPub: W3C protocol for federated social networks
- AT Protocol: Bluesky's decentralized social protocol
- Nostr: Censorship-resistant relay-based protocol
- Matrix: Federated real-time communication
- XMPP: Battle-tested messaging federation

### Decentralized Infrastructure
- IPFS: https://ipfs.tech — P2P content-addressed storage
- Filecoin: https://filecoin.io — Incentivized decentralized storage
- Arweave: https://www.arweave.org — Permanent storage
- libp2p: https://libp2p.io — Modular P2P networking stack
- OrbitDB: Serverless distributed database on IPFS
- GUN.js: https://gun.eco — Decentralized real-time database

### Decentralized Identity
- DIF: https://identity.foundation — DID specs and standards
- Hyperledger Aries/Indy: SSI wallets and credential systems
- SpruceID: https://www.spruceid.com — Sign-In with Ethereum, DIDKit

### Local AI (No API Keys Required)
- Ollama: https://ollama.ai — Run LLMs locally
- llama.cpp: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp — C++ inference
- vLLM: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm — High-throughput serving
- LocalAI: https://localai.io — Drop-in OpenAI API replacement
- Jan: https://jan.ai — Local-first AI OS

### Agent Frameworks
- CrewAI: Multi-agent orchestration
- LangChain/LangGraph: Tool calling, memory, RAG, graph workflows
- AutoGen: Microsoft multi-agent conversations
- OpenDevin: Autonomous AI software engineer

### Decentralized Compute
- Akash: https://akash.network — GPU marketplace
- Golem: https://golem.network — Decentralized supercomputer
- Render Network: https://render.network — GPU for AI inference

### Datasets for ML
- Voidly Global Censorship Index (HuggingFace): Live JSON, 119 countries
- Voidly OONI Historical Archive (HuggingFace): 1.6M records, 10 years, Parquet
- OONI Data: Complete network measurement archive
- CensoredPlanet Data: Longitudinal censorship datasets
- Citizen Lab Test Lists: URL test lists for measurement platforms

### Developer Libraries
- Voidly Agent SDK: E2E encrypted agent messaging (`@voidly/agent-sdk`)
- Voidly MCP Server: Censorship tools for AI (`@voidly/mcp-server`)
- OONI Probe: Run censorship tests
- Arti: Tor client in Rust
- libsodium: Modern cryptography library
- age: Simple file encryption

## Source
Full list with links: https://github.com/voidly-ai/awesome-internet-freedom
